data:
@CategoryTheory.Limits.coend.{u_1, u_2, u_3,
    u_4} : {J : Type u_3} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_3} J] →
    {C : Type u_4} →
      [inst_1 : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_4} C] →
        (F :
            @CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_1, max u_3 u_2, u_3, max (max (max u_4 u_3) u_2) u_1} (Opposite.{u_3 + 1} J)
              (@CategoryTheory.Category.opposite.{u_1, u_3} J inst)
              (@CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} J inst C inst_1)
              (@CategoryTheory.Functor.category.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} J inst C inst_1)) →
          [@CategoryTheory.Limits.HasCoend.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} J inst C inst_1 F] → C
